new_categories.label: dry_cargo_identity_traceability_service_readiness
new_categories.memory: Dry-cargo identity and traceability assurance is a delivered service-state distinct from physical segregation, quantity measurement and downstream commercial documentation outcomes.

new_categories.label: identity_reference_availability
new_categories.memory: Availability of a usable identity reference can be represented separately from whether that reference is aligned to the intended cargo lot or stowage scope.

new_categories.label: lot_parcel_scope_confidence
new_categories.memory: Traceability can be bounded to a lot, parcel, hold grouping, loading or discharge segment without retaining exact cargo descriptions, marks or document identifiers.

new_categories.label: stowage_zone_mapping_confidence
new_categories.memory: Confidence that an identified cargo lot remains mapped to the intended bounded stowage zone is distinct from the physical condition of the hold and from quantity measurement.

new_categories.label: marking_reference_alignment_confidence
new_categories.memory: Alignment between a physical marking/reference layer and the intended cargo identity can be represented without retaining exact marks, labels, identifiers or document entries.

new_categories.label: identity_reference_integrity_confidence
new_categories.memory: Identity-reference integrity can degrade independently from simple reference availability, without retaining the exact document, identifier or record content.

new_categories.label: cross_record_alignment_confidence
new_categories.memory: Agreement across bounded identity, tally, stowage or terminal reference layers can be represented as an alignment state without reproducing manifest, bill-of-lading or cargo-accounting records.

new_categories.label: independent_identity_crosscheck_confidence
new_categories.memory: Independent or alternate identity cross-check confidence can be represented separately from the primary reference path without retaining commercial reconciliation logic.

new_categories.label: cargo_operation_stage_traceability_confidence
new_categories.memory: Traceability confidence can be scoped to loading, onboard carriage, discharge or release stage without retaining exact commercial workflow or release rules.

new_categories.label: physical_segregation_not_identity_equivalence
new_categories.memory: Physical separation or bounded stowage does not by itself prove that the correct cargo identity, lot or reference alignment has been preserved.

new_categories.label: identity_traceability_degradation_lifecycle
new_categories.memory: Identity/traceability assurance can move through available, degraded, restricted, isolated, under-restoration and restored states with separate timestamps.

new_categories.label: scoped_traceability_restriction_downstream_not_root_cause
new_categories.memory: Restrictions can attach to identity reference, lot scope, mapping, alignment or cross-check state, while release uncertainty, claims, segregation concern, rework or schedule do not prove the root cause.

new_categories.label: multi_timestamp_traceability_restoration
new_categories.memory: Reference recovery, mapping verification, cross-record alignment, independent cross-check, cargo-release confidence and restriction release can occur at different times.

useful_refinements.label: identity_traceability_vs_physical_separation
useful_refinements.memory: P115 physical dunnage/lining/separation support does not establish cargo identity, lot/parcel reference or stowage-zone traceability alignment.

useful_refinements.label: identity_traceability_vs_quantity_measurement
useful_refinements.memory: P124 quantity/mass measurement and tally assurance establishes how much cargo is represented, not whether the correct cargo identity remains linked to the intended lot/parcel and stowage scope.

useful_refinements.label: traceability_state_vs_exact_document_workflow
useful_refinements.memory: A structural traceability assurance state is distinct from exact manifest, bill-of-lading, marking, release or commercial documentation workflow.

useful_refinements.label: identity_alignment_vs_release_or_claims_outcome
useful_refinements.memory: Cargo-release, claims or reconciliation outcomes are downstream states and should remain separate from the underlying identity, mapping and alignment confidence.

duplicates.label: generic_reference_scope_alignment_crosscheck_pattern
duplicates.memory: Generic availability, bounded scope, alignment and independent cross-check mechanics repeat prior assurance families.

duplicates.label: generic_scoped_restriction_downstream_restoration
duplicates.memory: Generic restriction/isolation, downstream-effect separation and multi-stage restoration are already campaign-wide.

stop_reason: The bounded dry-cargo identity/lot/parcel and stowage-zone traceability questions are answered; further recall trends toward exact marks, identifiers, documents, coordinates, rules, commercial workflows, providers or incidents that are deferred to Evidence.
epistemic_boundary: Memory-only defensive dry-cargo identity/lot/parcel and stowage-zone traceability orientation and source-discovery output; not manifest, bill-of-lading, marking, custody, release, claims or commercial-reconciliation guidance and not proof of any exact identifier, document content, location, rule, procedure, provider, dispute or current-readiness fact.
